sentences.text:
Learned trial judge, Jhansi shall forthwith send a report regarding the status of the trial and cause for the delay in concluding the trial in Case Crime No. 113 of 2015 under Sections 66(gha) of IT Act and Section 420 IPC, Police Station-Kotwali District Jhansi with the following details in tabulated form:-
(1) Number of prosecution witnesses proposed to be examined as per the charge sheet.
(2) Number of prosecution witnesses who have been examined before the trial court with dates.
(3) Number of witnesses who have been summoned but have not attended the trial proceedings on the appointed dates with dates.
(4) Number of witnesses against whom coercive measures have been taken out with dates.

District Legal Services Authority, Jhansi shall submit a report with the following details:
A. The socioeconomic background of the applicant.
B. Whether the applicant is being informed about the status of his bail application on a regular basis by his pairokar/office of his counsel or any other sources ?
C. Whether the applicant is aware or apprised of his rights to get his bail application heard at an early date?
D. Whether the applicant has the resources to realise the aforesaid rights?

E. Steps taken by the District Legal Services Authority, to comply with the directions rendered by this Court in Anil Gaur @ Sonu @ Sonu Tomar Vs. State of U.P (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 16961 of 2022). F. The nature of cooperation required from the District authorities, Jail authorities and other administrative authorities, if any, in compliance of the directions issued by this Court in Anil Gaur (supra).

entities.text: Anil Gaur @ Sonu @ Sonu Tomar Vs. State of U.P (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 16961 of 2022)

sentences.text: Office is directed to communicate a copy of this order to the learned District Judge, Jhansi.
Put up this case peremptorily on 30.01.2023 in the additional cause list.
